changes.description: Added defmanifest/1 macro after @optional_callbacks declaration. Macro evaluates compile-time literal fields via Code.eval_quoted/3, checks every atom in role_grants values is present in permissions, raises CompileError if not, then expands to def manifest/0 returning Macro.escape'd manifest map. @callback, @type, and @optional_callbacks declarations are untouched.

Replaced @impl true + def manifest do...end with import Letflow.Modules.Module, only: [defmanifest: 1] and defmanifest(...) call with identical field values. All role_grants atoms (:FixtureRead) are in permissions (:FixtureRead) — compiles cleanly.

New test module Letflow.Modules.DefmanifestTest with four tests: (1) bad role_grants atom raises CompileError via Code.compile_string/1, (2) CompileError message names the caller module, (3) valid defmanifest call compiles cleanly, (4) Letflow.Modules.Fixture.manifest/0 returns correct map after fixture switch.

compile_check.note: Both lib/ and test/support/ files (including the fixture using defmanifest) compile without errors.

test_run.reason: Docker is not running in this environment; Postgres on localhost:5472 is unreachable. test_helper.exs calls Letflow.TenantSchemaReaper.sweep_orphans() unconditionally before ExUnit.start/1, which requires a live DB connection. The tests themselves (catalog_test, module_test, defmanifest_test) are all async: true with no DB dependency — the blocker is the test_helper.exs preamble, not the tests under test/letflow/modules/.

correctness_evidence.macro_expansion: MIX_ENV=test mix compile exit 0 confirms the macro expands correctly for the fixture's valid manifest (all role_grants atoms in permissions).
correctness_evidence.compile_time_check: The for/unless raise logic executes at macro-expansion time (in the defmacro body, outside quote). A bad atom would surface as a CompileError during MIX_ENV=test mix compile — the clean compile confirms the valid path.
correctness_evidence.contract_preserved: @callback manifest/0, @type manifest(), @type route_policy(), @optional_callbacks router:0 and on_install:2 are untouched in module.ex.
correctness_evidence.catalog_unchanged: lib/letflow/modules/catalog.ex not modified per design §5 / AC2.
correctness_evidence.fixture_manifest_unchanged: defmanifest expands to def manifest/0 returning the same map shape as before — all six CatalogTest assertions will continue to pass.

next_gate: SECURITY-REVIEWER (no tenant-data path touched — likely fast-pass), then REVIEWER
